title: docs(checklist-test): a QA security finding gets no card and goes privately to the PM session, runners only test, and runner dispatches state effort by card shape
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DCvt1Z3RM8RYroegHc3zfLi)_
Fixes #27382
Fixes #27390

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:测试中遇到的安全问题不再立任何 GitHub 卡,复现经会话间消息私下报给派发会话,由它派修复并持有 PR;runner 只测试;runner 派发按卡定 effort(跑测 `high`,修安全与对抗复核 `xhigh`),并记花费。
- 为什么改:你 10-29 的几句话(汇总在 #27377 评论 6500750765);只写 detail withheld 的卡仍在公开仓里预告某项有洞;第三波 runner 没人定 effort,一张卡半小时花了 $33。
- 风险与回滚:只改规则文本(RUNNER 规则 2、checklist-test 技能、os-dev 两行、行数棘轮上限),不动产品代码;回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md` 规则 2 的两条子项;`.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md` 的 Guardrails 与 §2。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet && node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs`,两者 exit 0。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(Tier S,欠一次契约档复审)。

## What changes

One rule, written in both places — `docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md` rule 2 and `.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md` — and neither text claims precedence over the other.

**Security findings (#27382).** A security finding is an authentication or authorization hole, or any finding whose reproduction is an exploit recipe.
- It gets **no GitHub card at all**. That includes the withheld-detail card, and it is not mentioned on the wave anchor or a tracking card either. Its reproduction appears nowhere on GitHub.
- The run record keeps one row, `area.item · clause · security finding — detail withheld, reported to PM`. That row is a completed verdict, and the title counts it as a `FAIL`.
- The runner reports the reproduction privately to the session that dispatched it, by session-to-session message.
- That PM session dispatches the fix through pm-dispatch: an in-seat `os-dev` subagent at `xhigh`, with the reproduction only in the dispatch prompt and hardening-only wording in the PR, commit and changeset. A finding that needs a contract decision first goes to the maintainer.

**Runners only test (#27382, widened to issues and PRs).**
- Every GitHub write and every issue or PR handling step of a run (extraction, dedupe, close-out) goes through the pm-dispatch write doors.
- A runner never spawns `os-dev` and never drives a PR. The dispatching PM session owns every PR the run produces: review, contract review where it is owed, readiness and landing.
- When a runner's own permission check refuses a write door, it stages the writes in a file, reports the path and hands off. The dispatching session reads them and posts them through the same doors in the staged order. A staged file never carries a security reproduction.

**Runner effort (#27390), skill §2 only.**
- Effort by card shape, stated in every runner dispatch, never empty. A run card (Tier 1 pin batch, manual API/CLI or browser set, P0 smoke, UX walkthrough) is `high`. `xhigh` is only for the `os-dev` that fixes a security finding and for adversarial re-verification of a contested verdict.
- Per backend:
  - An `Agent` subagent gets `effort` passed explicitly, and the skill line is what makes passing it lawful.
  - A cloud card (`create_session`) takes no effort. Its record carries no effort field either (measured, below), so the dispatch note says "not set" plus the dispatching session's own level. When that level is above the card's shape, the dispatcher follows the dispatch-runbook's 〈云卡五课〉 item 五 ② line, which the skill cites rather than restates, or opens a project thread instead and sets its effort at spawn.
- The spend line: the wave anchor's dispatch note and each runner's final report carry each card's spend at report time, read from `get_session` `external_metadata.usage.cost_usd`.

**Files.**
- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md`: rule 2's carve-out is rewritten, and a new sub-bullet, "The runner only tests", is added. Two later mentions of the retired card shape now match it: the *Run records* paragraph and the *Extraction obligation* bullet.
- `.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md`:
  - Guardrails: the security bullet is rewritten, and a "runner 只测试" bullet is added.
  - §4: the extraction line is rewritten, and the write-door paragraph now covers issue and PR handling and the refused door.
  - §2: three bullets cover effort, backends and spend, and the QA-run line names PR ownership.
- `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`: two existing lines now carry the no-card dispatch. The dispatch prompt stands in for the card, there is no `Fixes #`, and the report is the final message only. No line is added (402 lines, ceiling 402).
- `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`: the `checklist-test/SKILL.md` ceiling goes from 246 to 259.

## Why

The maintainer's words on 2026-10-29 in the dispatching session, verbatim and untranslated, all collected on #27377 in **comment 6500750765** (the ruling of record):
- 「你应该使用 pm-dispatch 技能处理 issue」
- 「对于测试中遇到的安全问题，不适合提交issue 的，只是使用pm-dispatch技能派发」
- 「这些都应该写到 checklist skills 中」
- widening (#27382, 6493929972): 「每个会话我都交代了：你应该使用 pm-dispatch 技能处理 issue 和 pr」
- scope change (#27382, 6493958591), which replaces "the runner dispatches the fix": 「但是我建议开发任务是不是应该由你同意派，云agent 只负责测试，能做到吗？安全问题他可以私下报告给你吗」
- #27390: 「你派的任务都需要 extra 吗」, then 「立卡更新 skills」

**pm-skill line ratchet raise.** Ruling of record: #27377 comment **6500750765**. Measured line delta: **+13**, `.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md` 246 → 259. The `CEILINGS` row moves by exactly that amount. No other ceiling moves, and `os-dev.md` stays at 402.

## Measured before writing (#27390 item 2)

All readings were taken with `get_session` on 2026-10-29, between 15:20Z and 15:30Z.

| session | kind | `session_context.effort_level` |
|---|---|---|
| project coordinator `session_016WV4cyMsvviaf7j5XzQrfC` | parent of the two threads below | `low` |
| this card thread `session_016WV4cxs6a1nUyBHTEo84qV` | project thread, spawned by the coordinator | `xhigh` |
| sibling card thread `session_016WV4d1oYpq8eEjYF141fC3` | project thread, spawned in the same minute | `xhigh` |
| devx seat thread `session_01LKHDniRQSWjRJyDtacwpEd` | project thread | `high` |
| spec seat 1 `session_01HjR8RUwTPQ3TgbfKihmxp9` | dispatching seat (web) | `xhigh` |
| its card `session_01GDoMKJFY45jdSGzFmyumij` (origin `claude_code_mcp_seed`) | `create_session` cloud card | **field absent** |
| services seat 2 `session_018VqJPGA1NDNSCZsnecsChP` | dispatching seat (web) | `xhigh` |
| its card `session_013JuCowY7RrGXYbGEv3cWsQ` (origin `claude_code_mcp_seed`) | `create_session` cloud card | **field absent** |

What this shows:
- A project thread runs at the level it was given at spawn, not at its parent's.
- A `create_session` card's record carries no effort level at all, so nobody can read back the level it ran at. That is why the skill tells the dispatcher to record "not set" and the dispatching session's level, and does not claim an inherited level.
- `usage.cost_usd` sits at `external_metadata.usage.cost_usd`, and a session with no finished turn has no `usage` block yet (this thread's own record at 15:18Z).

## Acceptance notes

- **The file surface is widened by two RUNNER.md mentions outside rule 2.** The *Run records* paragraph and the *Extraction obligation* bullet repeated the retired withheld-card shape, so left alone they would have contradicted rule 2. They are in the same file, and `docs/qa/**` is not governed. Declared to the seat.
- **Three checklist item strings still quote the retired `detail withheld pending maintainer` wording**, as pointers to rule 2's carve-out: one in `areas/access-security.json` and two in `areas/identity-auth.json`. They defer to rule 2, which governs. Rewording them is an item revision (a `revision` bump and a `history` row), which is outside this card's surface. Left for the seat: either a follow-up or noted only.
- **pm-dispatch `dispatch-runbook.md` 〈云卡五课〉 item 五 ② says a session that cannot take effort inherits the seat's level.** The readings above cannot confirm that for `create_session` cards, because their record has no effort field. The runbook is not edited here (pm-dispatch is outside this surface). The skill cites the line and records what can be read.
- **Tier.** Touching `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` makes `dispatch-gates --tier` derive a MANDATORY contract-review tier for the surface. The two-line amendment there is one-line-class and mechanical. The build ran at the default tier, and the contract-tier review the seat arranges is the compensating control.
- **No PR assignee.** `os-dev.md` says a PR carries none, and the maintainer reaches the PR through the seat's hand-off.
